description:
Encrypted direct device-to-device file transfer.

RelayPony for the desktop sends and receives files between your computer and your phones, encrypted end to end with the age protocol. Pairs by QR code with the RelayPony iOS and Android apps. No server, no cloud, no account.
Extends the Linux file-picker fix to the .deb and the portable tarball. The AppImage was fixed in 2.2.0 and the AUR package shortly after, but the .deb and tarball kept shipping the unwrapped launcher; this build wraps them too. If you use the AppImage or the AUR package, nothing here changes for you.

Upgrading: nothing to do beyond installing the new build. Identities, pairings, and the transfer format are unchanged.
